summary: This note describes South Central Coast (Vietnamese: Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ), one of Vietnam's regions. It consists of the independent municipality of Đà Nẵng and seven other provinces. The note says the two southern provinces, Ninh Thuận and Bình Thuận, are sometimes seen as part of the Southeast region, and that the Paracel Islands (Hoàng Sa District) and Spratly Islands (Trường Sa District) also belong to this region.
one_line: South Central Coast is a Vietnamese region made up of Đà Nẵng and seven provinces, and it includes the Paracel and Spratly Islands.
key_facts: South Central Coast (Vietnamese: Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ) is one of the regions of Vietnam.
South Central Coast consists of the independent municipality of Đà Nẵng and seven other provinces.
The two southern provinces of South Central Coast, Ninh Thuận and Bình Thuận, are sometimes seen as part of the Southeast region.
The Paracel Islands, also called Hoàng Sa District, are part of the South Central Coast region.
The Spratly Islands, also called Trường Sa District, are part of the South Central Coast region.
Đà Nẵng is an independent municipality within the South Central Coast region.
Ninh Thuận and Bình Thuận are the two southern provinces of the South Central Coast region.
The Vietnamese name of South Central Coast is Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ.
